subject: Observability add-on pricing and bundle question
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire@applaunch.io>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Applaunch Procurement <procurement@applaunch.io>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-on quote and a few questions

Hi Sofía —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're close to making a call but need a clearer picture on add-on costs. High level: Applaunch wants to enable longer retention for logs/traces + advanced dashboards for product analytics. Current asks:
- Retention: move from 14 days to 90 days for logs (estimated 12 TB/month ingest).
- Tracing: keep 30 days retained, want sampling + full-trace storage for 20% of spans.
- Advanced Dashboards: 10 named seats + 3 dashboard templates with live refresh.

Could you send an itemized quote for those add-ons, plus (1) any bundle discount if we commit to a 12-month add-on spend, (2) pilot credits for the first 90 days, and (3) notes on data residency / SOC2 evidence.

I've attached the draft SOW we started (Applaunch_SOW_v1.docx) so you can see scope. Procurement will need an invoice/PO workflow and any standard T&C exceptions listed up front.

Looking for a call this week to finalize — Tue/Wed mornings PST work best.

Best,
Claire Ng
Head of Platform Engineering
Applaunch
[Attachment: Applaunch_SOW_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@applaunch.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on quote and a few questions

Hi Claire —

Thanks — appreciate the SOW. Quick high-level quote below; I'll follow up with a clean PDF offer and a suggested mutual action plan. Numbers are list prices (USD).

- Retention (logs): 90-day bucket = $0.045 per GB-month. Estimated monthly charge for 12 TB ingest: 12,000 GB * $0.045 = $540 / month storage add-on (note: ingestion egress/processing billed separately at $0.008 per 1k requests).
- Tracing: Full-trace storage tier: $0.065 per GB-month for retained spans; sampling & indexing surcharge: $0.02 per 1k spans.
- Advanced Dashboards: $150 per named seat / month; templates & live refresh = $300 monthly platform fee for dashboard compute.

Bundle guidance: 10–15% discount on add-ons for 12-month committed spend above $120k ARR; pilot credits available (typically $5k–$15k depending on scope).

Compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II PDF, data residency options (US-only) and an evidence packet.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send a formal offer PDF (Redwood-Obs-Offer-Apr2026.pdf) with two skus: pilot (3 months) and 12-month committed pricing.
2) Schedule a 30-min procurement + engineering call (Wed 10:30am PST suggested).

Would you be able to share a target budget/range for these add-ons? That will help me propose an actionable discount path.

Thanks,
Sofía Ivanova
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Obs-Offer-Apr2026.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Claire Ng <claire@applaunch.io>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Applaunch Procurement <procurement@applaunch.io>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-on quote and a few questions

Hi Sofía —

Thanks for the quick breakdown. A couple of clarifications and asks from procurement/finance:
1) We were hoping for a stronger first-year concession — is 15% the best you can do on the bundle for a 12-mo commit? Our procurement target is ~20% off list for year one.
2) Pilot credits: can we get $10k credit to offset initial ingest / onboarding costs?
3) Can you confirm the dashboard seat pricing includes SSO and role-based access? We need enterprise SSO (SAML) included.
4) Legal will need a DocuSign-ready SOW and a standard invoice template (Net 30).

We can commit to a minimum spend of $9k/month on add-ons for 12 months if that helps accelerate a better discount.

Available for a call Wed 10:30am PST.

Best,
Claire

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Observability concession request — Applaunch

Folks — forwarding Applaunch's concession ask. Key items: 20% target first-year discount, $10k pilot credit, confirm SAML/SSO and DocuSign SOW.

My suggested concession structure (for internal alignment):
- Offer an 18% first-year discount on add-ons if Applaunch signs a 12-month add-on commit at $9k+/month (as they proposed).
- Provide a $10k pilot credit applied to first two invoices (non-refundable; must complete onboarding).
- Include SAML SSO at no extra charge for dashboard seats (standard entitlement).
- Require standard Redwood Addendum (no bespoke legal exceptions) — Laura pls confirm acceptable.

Rationale: 18% hits close to their ask while protecting margin; $10k pilot credit is reasonable for the expected onboarding work. We should also require a 30-day notice for seat reductions.

Can Jordan/Laura confirm if the credit amount and discount are supportable from finance/legal? If yes I can present this on Wed.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — West
Redwood Inference

Hi Claire —

Following internal review we can move forward with the following commercial offer to close quickly. The summary below is the binding commercial terms we will put into the SOW and DocuSign envelope:

Commercial summary (USD, monthly unless noted):
- Logs retention (90-day bucket): list $0.045/GB-month; applied to estimated 12 TB/month = $540/mo storage delta.
- Tracing: full-trace storage tier $0.065/GB-month; sampling surcharge unchanged.
- Advanced Dashboards: $150/seat/month x 10 seats = $1,500/mo; dashboard compute fee $300/mo.

Concession:
- 18% off the combined add-on list prices for year one (applies to retention + tracing + dashboard seat fees).
- $10,000 pilot credit (applied to first two invoices; credit requires completion of technical onboarding checklist).
- SAML SSO included for named dashboard seats at no additional charge.

Commitment & terms:
- Minimum committed spend: $9,000/month for 12 months (applies to add-ons).
- Billing: Net 30. Redwood will provide invoice template and DocuSign-ready SOW.
- Legal: Redwood standard Addendum will be used; any redlines must be returned within 7 business days to avoid start delays.

Attachments & next steps:
- I attached the formal offer PDF (Redwood-Obs-Offer-Apr2026.pdf) and SOC 2 summary.
- Please confirm whether Applaunch accepts the 12-month $9k/month commit with the 18% concession. If yes, procurement can issue a PO and we'll send the DocuSign SOW.
- Suggested call: Wed 10:30am PST to finalize — I'll send a calendar invite.

If procurement needs a different amortization or an alternate invoicing cadence, we can discuss but that may change the effective discount.

Thanks and talk soon,
